sessions.summary: Complete overhaul: docs, code audit, noise tolerance, multilingual stop words

2. AGENTS.md updated with full 60+ file architecture tree

6. COLLABORATION_SCENARIOS.md (899 lines): 27-tool chaining, multi-agent pipelines, fine-tuning, workflow templates

15. All 641 unit tests passing after every change
16. Telegram notifications for every push (token in scripts/telegram.sh)
key_decisions: Separate postbuild hook instead of inline build script (cleaner npm lifecycle)
postbuild only runs if opencode cache dir exists (no error if missing)
scripts/telegram.sh added to .gitignore to prevent bot token leak
tsconfig 'types': ['node'] instead of changing lib to 'dom'
Fixed 270 findings by priority: HIGH → MEDIUM → LOW via 7 parallel sub-agents
Sliding window (last 20) replaces cumulative for all metrics (more accurate)
Semantic gate: ≥2 action verbs + min 60 chars for skill extraction
TF-IDF relevance scoring with recency + success bonuses for skill search
Multi-language strategy: English-first, Indonesian-second, 56 other languages via stopwords-iso
Auto-evolution requires sustained degradation (3 consecutive bucket drops) + 2min cooldown
Knowledge artifact force-tracked despite .agentic/ being gitignored
